sections.heading: Compare configuration and model limits
sections.question: Which configuration should enter the shortlist?
sections.required_limitation: Fixture clearance and dynamic loads remain unassessed.

selected_facts.quote: SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: NCX7 nominal travels are 700 mm X, 450 mm Y and 500 mm Z; fixture and tool clearance must be checked separately.
SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: NCX7 proposed table load is 400 kg including fixtures, centered and static; off-center and dynamic loads remain unassessed.
SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: NCX10 nominal travels are 1000 mm X, 550 mm Y and 550 mm Z; fixture and tool clearance must be checked separately.
SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: NCX10 proposed table load is 650 kg including fixtures, centered and static; off-center and dynamic loads remain unassessed.
SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: an 800 mm by 480 mm fixture totaling 520 kg exceeds NCX7 table width and proposed load; NCX10 remains a candidate pending travel, access and dynamic-load checks.

sections.verification_action: Send the fixture layout for configuration review.

sections.heading: Read spindle and cutting trial evidence
sections.question: What do spindle ratings establish under the recorded conditions?

selected_facts.quote: SYNTHETIC ONLY: NovaCNC NCX7 spindle rated 7200 rpm continuously under NOVA-TEST-7 protocol at 20 C on an unloaded bench; applies only to NCX7 and is not a cutting-load or production guarantee.
SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: NCX7 continuous motor nameplate is 7.5 kW; this is not measured cutting power and does not establish a torque curve.
SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: NCX10 continuous motor nameplate is 11 kW; this is not measured cutting power and does not establish a torque curve.
SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: NCX10 spindle rated 10000 rpm continuously under NOVA-TEST-10 at 20 C on an unloaded bench; loaded cutting and production remain unassessed.

sections.verification_action: Request a representative loaded trial and torque records.

sections.heading: Machine and application fit
sections.question: Does the supplied trial represent the intended material and cycle?
sections.required_limitation: Other applications require new representative trials.

selected_facts.quote: SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: both aluminum trials use 6061-T6 blanks 120 mm by 80 mm by 30 mm and fixture A on pocket drawing A; thin walls and deep cavities remain unassessed.
SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: NCX7 aluminum trial mean cycle was 42 s across three runs on drawing A, excluding loading; the small sample establishes no general throughput advantage.
SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: NCX10 aluminum trial mean cycle was 40 s across three runs on drawing A, excluding loading; the small sample establishes no general throughput advantage.
SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: titanium, hardened steel and unattended production need new representative trials; the supplied records establish no suitability conclusion for these applications.

sections.verification_action: Submit the intended material, drawing and complete cycle.

sections.heading: Specify representative acceptance tests
sections.question: What do measured results establish for acceptance?
sections.required_limitation: The samples do not establish production capability.

selected_facts.quote: SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: NCX7 aluminum coupon measured +/-0.02 mm at 20 C under NOVA-MEASURE-A with fixture A; other geometries and production remain unassessed.
SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: NOVA-MEASURE-A checks outer width on three coupons per machine using a comparator with assumed uncertainty 0.005 mm; bore position and surface finish remain unassessed.
SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: both aluminum trials use 6061-T6 blanks 120 mm by 80 mm by 30 mm and fixture A on pocket drawing A; thin walls and deep cavities remain unassessed.
SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: proposed outer width criterion is +/-0.025 mm on three consecutive drawing A coupons with assumed uncertainty 0.005 mm; the measurement decision rule requires agreement.

sections.verification_action: Agree a representative measurement and uncertainty procedure.

sections.heading: Procurement and acceptance
sections.question: What needs agreement before the purchase order?

selected_facts.quote: SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: the proposed RFQ includes drawing revision, material, critical tolerances, fixture layout, tool list, target cycle and utilities; supplier review remains required.
SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: production cycle criteria remain to be negotiated with loading and tool changes defined explicitly; bench cycle timings are not contractual production limits.
SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: buyer approves the test drawing, supplier records setup and measurements, and both parties agree disposition and re-test after correction before shipment release.

sections.verification_action: Send the RFQ fields and negotiate acceptance responsibilities.

sections.heading: Agree delivery training and support
sections.question: What delivery and support terms apply to the quoted configuration?
sections.required_limitation: The proposals are not signed commitments.

selected_facts.quote: SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: both base configurations are three-axis; rotary, probing and through-spindle coolant are separately quoted options with untested applicability.
SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: confirm the quoted control, spindle, coolant, tool layout and options against the tested base configuration; fixture A records do not validate optional equipment.
SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: base-machine dispatch is proposed within 60 days after deposit and signed configuration; options may change the schedule and international transit is excluded.

SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: training proposes 2 days of English remote sessions for designated operators on base operation and maintenance; advanced programming and on-site commissioning require separate agreement.
SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: initial email support response is proposed within 2 business days after a ticket with diagnostics under the declared support calendar; restoration time is not promised.
SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: proposed parts warranty is 12 months from dispatch for diagnosed manufacturing defects; consumables, misuse and travel are excluded and final signed terms are pending.

sections.verification_action: Confirm the configuration register and commercial terms in writing.

validator_contract.customer_claim_rule: Propose NEW evidence-based analysis; never copy preapproved interpretations. OBSERVED_PRODUCT_FACT must be an exact quote with one ref. All claims use text, claim_type, page_refs, source_refs, customer_refs. E refs cannot be replaced by P/S. EVIDENCE_BASED_INTERPRETATION must add proposal metadata: procurement_question, reasoning, assumptions, limitation, procurement_action. Python attaches exact premise quotes, conditions and source versions. Keep limitation and procurement_action verbatim in text; use the section question. Candidates are PENDING_REVIEW, never delivery eligible. No approval fields. Preserve subjects, numbers, units, conditions and scope. Editorial/CTA contains no facts.
validator_contract.customer_coverage_rule: Select only facts needed to answer the reader questions; the fact bank is not an all-ref quota. Use exact direct facts or genuine interpretation premises, never irrelevant refs for coverage. Preserve each section supporting_evidence and requirement_ids coverage.
validator_contract.page_source_role: PLANNING_CONTEXT_ONLY: pages, sources and content_points P/S reference/type hints describe the planning graph, not E article claim permissions. Use the E contract and section map.

writing_brief.goal: SYNTHETIC / TEST ONLY: English CNC machining center buyer guide for export procurement teams: model selection, spindle tests, material/cycle fit, measured results, RFQ/acceptance and delivery/training/support. Explain implications, applicability and limits; no engineering approval.
instructions: Answer every reader question using the section evidence map; distinguish facts, reviewed interpretations and unknowns.
Keep background concise. Explain purchasing implications and end with a concrete RFQ or verification CTA.
writing_brief.reader_problem: Shortlist equipment for a defined application and agree how suitability and commercial obligations will be verified.
writing_brief.search_intent: Commercial investigation: compare conditional choices and prepare a verifiable enquiry.
